ideas.title: Night Shift
ideas.pitch: A skeleton crew of AI agents that ships while your org sleeps: Spec Gate, parallel headless workers, property-test gates, a deterministic autonomy policy and a morning briefing. Two apps from one skeleton.
ideas.kiro: Crew bots + conductor, CLI headless, specs, steering, hooks, MCP, PBT, custom agents, powers

ideas.title: Lazarus (app 1 of Night Shift)
ideas.pitch: Resurrect a 2003-style Perl CGI bulletin board: specs from existing behaviour, characterization tests, modern rewrite, differential HTTP parity proof.
ideas.kiro: Brownfield specs, legacy-oracle MCP, PBT parity, hooks

ideas.title: Chimera (app 2 of Night Shift)
ideas.pitch: A spreadsheet whose cells are formulas, shell pipelines or HTTP calls, recalculated over a dependency graph; built greenfield from one intent paragraph.
ideas.kiro: Greenfield spec pipeline, PBT recalculation properties, sandboxing policy

ideas.title: Dead Letter Office
ideas.pitch: Find dead links in docs, resurrect them from the Wayback Machine (snapshot nearest the git-blame date) or a verified replacement, with evidence per fix.
ideas.kiro: Hooks (link check on save), own MCP, PBT (only link targets change, idempotent), custom agents

ideas.title: Necromancer
ideas.pitch: Revive abandoned open-source libraries and prove behavioural parity with differential property-based tests; specs from the issue backlog.
ideas.kiro: Specs from issues, PBT parity, hooks, own MCP, custom agents

ideas.title: NetNews 2.0
ideas.pitch: Usenet reborn: NNTP-compatible newsgroups where humans and AI agents post, queryable over MCP.
ideas.kiro: MCP as the product, spec for an NNTP subset, PBT on threading

ideas.title: HyperCard Reborn
ideas.pitch: Stacks of cards with a tiny scripting language; an LLM turns plain English into card scripts.
ideas.kiro: Spec-driven interpreter, PBT parser round-trip, steering for the DSL

ideas.title: BBS Sysop
ideas.pitch: Dial-up-style BBS with door games and an AI sysop in the browser.
ideas.kiro: Vibe vs spec comparison, hooks for moderation tests

ideas.title: Teletext 2.0
ideas.pitch: Numbered pages of AI-summarised news, prices and results for 2G and SMS users.
ideas.kiro: Steering for plain-language rules, MCP data sources, PBT page-size limits

ideas.title: Rosetta Crypt
ideas.pitch: Translate legacy COBOL/Fortran/Pascal routines to modern code and prove equivalence with differential property tests.
ideas.kiro: Specs per routine, PBT is the product, MCP reference interpreter

ideas.title: Format Morgue
ideas.pitch: Revive obsolete file formats with spec-driven converters; round-trip properties verify no data loss.
ideas.kiro: Spec per format, PBT round-trip, byte-level steering

ideas.title: Afterlife
ideas.pitch: Rescue your data from shut-down services by importing your own export archives into open formats, with a completeness report.
ideas.kiro: Specs per archive format, PBT no-item-lost, MCP to query the archive

ideas.title: Revive a Language
ideas.pitch: Community dictionary and spaced-repetition app for an endangered language; needs real community partners.
ideas.kiro: Steering for consent and attribution, PBT scheduler

ideas.title: Séance
ideas.pitch: Repo autopsy from git history, AST, logs and an LLM, with an ask-the-dead-codebase chat.
ideas.kiro: Custom agents, MCP over git, hooks

ideas.title: Pipes & Cells
ideas.pitch: Spreadsheet whose cells are shell pipelines and MCP calls on a dataflow graph. (Night Shift's Chimera is a scoped version.)
ideas.kiro: Spec for dependency graph, PBT recalculation, MCP cell functions

ideas.title: Reanimated SQL
ideas.pitch: Every row change is a git commit; query as-of any time; branch and merge tables.
ideas.kiro: PBT merge invariants, specs for storage format

ideas.title: Tarot Postmortem
ideas.pitch: Blameless incident timelines stitched from logs, alerts and chat exports with a tarot-style narrative.
ideas.kiro: Steering for tone, hooks for PII scrubbing, MCP log sources

ideas.title: Spectral Shell
ideas.pitch: Voice-controlled terminal for developers with limited mobility, with a safety layer that always confirms destructive commands.
ideas.kiro: Steering risk taxonomy, PBT on the safety classifier, hooks

ideas.title: Spec Autopsy
ideas.pitch: Linter for Kiro specs: EARS validity, traceability, orphan tasks, vague words; drafts property tests from criteria.
ideas.kiro: Dogfoods specs and PBT, MCP server, hook

ideas.title: Bones
ideas.pitch: One spec generates data model, API, MCP server and UI; two apps from it.
ideas.kiro: Specs are the framework, steering as template rules

ideas.title: Ribcage
ideas.pitch: Template for production-grade MCP servers: auth, rate limits, tests, PBT harness, docs.
ideas.kiro: MCP, PBT, hooks, powers

ideas.title: Marrow
ideas.pitch: Local-first offline-sync skeleton with CRDTs; two apps (grocery list, field-inspection forms).
ideas.kiro: PBT for CRDT convergence, specs

ideas.title: Vertebrae
ideas.pitch: Minimal evaluation harness for LLM apps: datasets, graders, regression gates, report page.
ideas.kiro: PBT grader consistency, hooks as regression gates

ideas.title: Hexa-Core
ideas.pitch: One domain core with CLI, web and chat-bot front ends generated from a spec.
ideas.kiro: Spec to ports and adapters, architecture steering

ideas.title: Ledger of the Dead
ideas.pitch: Budget and habit tracker where ghosts represent unpaid bills and abandoned goals.
ideas.kiro: Design steering, contrast hook

ideas.title: Spirit Board Flashcards
ideas.pitch: Spaced repetition where forgotten cards become ghosts you re-bind by recall.
ideas.kiro: PBT scheduler, design steering

ideas.title: Haunted On-Call
ideas.pitch: Incident triage dashboard: alerts as apparitions, runbooks as exorcisms.
ideas.kiro: MCP alert sources, hooks, severity specs

ideas.title: Ghost Cartographer
ideas.pitch: Haunted map of local folklore from open datasets.
ideas.kiro: Design steering, a11y hooks

ideas.title: Mourning Reader
ideas.pitch: Reading app where text materialises line by line; dyslexia-friendly, reduced-motion safe.
ideas.kiro: PBT pagination, a11y hooks

ideas.title: Steering Lab
ideas.pitch: A/B harness: does this steering doc actually change Kiro's output?
ideas.kiro: Steering is the subject, CLI batch runs, agents as graders

ideas.title: Spec Archaeology
ideas.pitch: Reverse-engineer EARS requirements and property tests from a legacy app's observed behaviour.
ideas.kiro: Reverse spec flow, PBT, strong startup story

ideas.title: A Kiro Power
ideas.pitch: Package a focused, high-quality Power (MCP tools + steering + docs) and show it improving a real build.
ideas.kiro: Power authoring end to end

ideas.title: Graveyard Shift Ops
ideas.pitch: Autonomous overnight on-call: bots triage alerts, reproduce failures, open fix PRs with evidence, and brief humans in the morning. A third app for the Night Shift skeleton.
ideas.kiro: Crew bots and schedules, CLI headless workers, hooks, policy tiers, PBT on triage rules

ideas.title: Policy Phantom
ideas.pitch: Stitch compliance control text, infrastructure-as-code and an LLM: turn controls into executable checks and evidence collectors, with a gap report.
ideas.kiro: Specs from control text, PBT on check logic, MCP evidence sources, hooks

ideas.title: Legacy Whisperer
ideas.pitch: Resurrect lost knowledge: turn an undocumented codebase into a living wiki, architecture diagrams and ask-the-code chat, with specs regenerated as it changes.
ideas.kiro: Brownfield specs, steering generation, MCP over the repo, custom agents

ideas.title: Dependency Reaper
ideas.pitch: Mass-migrate deprecated APIs across a monorepo with codemods, one reviewable PR per rule, each backed by test evidence.
ideas.kiro: Specs per migration rule, PBT behaviour preservation, parallel headless workers

ideas.title: Spec Drift Watch
ideas.pitch: A bot that detects when code drifts away from its Kiro specs: stale requirements, orphan tasks, untested criteria, with a traceability matrix.
ideas.kiro: Specs, PBT regeneration, Crew bot, hooks, MCP

ideas.title: Executable README
ideas.pitch: Revive stale docs by running every code sample in a README or docs site, fixing the broken ones, and proving the fixes still work.
ideas.kiro: Hooks on save, PBT (only samples change), own MCP sandbox

ideas.title: Paper Revival
ideas.pitch: Resurrect the code behind old research papers (dead dependencies, Python 2) and check that the reported numbers still reproduce within tolerance.
ideas.kiro: Specs from the paper's claims, numeric-tolerance property tests, sandboxed workers

ideas.title: Open Data Revenant
ideas.pitch: Rebuild vanished public datasets and feeds from archived snapshots into queryable tables, with provenance for every row.
ideas.kiro: Specs per dataset, PBT provenance completeness, MCP over archives

ideas.title: Ossuary
ideas.pitch: A lean data-pipeline skeleton (ingest, validate, transform, report) with two apps: a civic open-data cleaner and a log analyser.
ideas.kiro: Specs as pipeline contracts, PBT schema invariants, steering for data rules

ideas.title: Hook Harness
ideas.pitch: A test harness for Kiro hooks: replay recorded session events through your hook files and assert what they do, so hooks stop being untested glue.
ideas.kiro: Hooks are the subject, PBT on hook inputs, CLI headless runs

ideas.title: Flake Exorcist
ideas.pitch: A bot that finds flaky tests by re-running with logged seeds, isolates the cause, and proposes minimal fixes as PRs.
ideas.kiro: Crew bot, hooks, PBT seeds, custom agents

ideas.title: Crypt Briefing UI
ideas.pitch: A polished haunted-mansion dashboard for Night Shift's morning briefing: overnight work as candles, exceptions as ghosts, spend as a ledger. Accessible and reduced-motion safe.
ideas.kiro: Design steering, a11y hooks, MCP data from the ledger

ideas.title: Ticket to Spec
ideas.pitch: Stitch support tickets, usage analytics and code ownership into ranked, ready-to-build EARS specs with an evidence trail back to the customers.
ideas.kiro: Specs from messy input, spec gate, MCP ticket and analytics sources, PBT on traceability

ideas.title: Boo Live
ideas.pitch: Night Shift's morning briefing presented by a live talking ghost: lip-synced speech, reacts to what happened overnight (calm for green nights, rattled for queued auth changes), always ends with one next step.
ideas.kiro: Specs for briefing content, steering for tone, MCP reads the ledger, hooks trigger reactions

ideas.title: Kiro Familiar
ideas.pitch: A desk-pet ghost that lives beside your editor and reacts to Kiro hook events in real time: cheers when tests pass, hides when a gate fails, yawns when the agent waits for you.
ideas.kiro: Hooks are the input (Agent Stop, Post Tool Use, File Save), local WebSocket bridge, steering for its personality

ideas.title: Avatar Bones
ideas.pitch: A Skeleton Crew template for live avatars: input adapters (webcam face, voice, text) to a rig (SVG or 3D) to outputs (browser, stream overlay). Two apps: Boo Live and a classroom tutor.
ideas.kiro: Specs per adapter contract, PBT on rig mapping (blendshapes stay in range), custom agents per adapter

ideas.title: Séance Standup
ideas.pitch: Each Kiro Crew bot gets an avatar and a voice; the morning standup is a short séance where each bot reports in turn, and you can interrupt to ask follow-ups.
ideas.kiro: Crew bots and memory, MCP over the ledger, steering per bot persona

ideas.title: Lab Ghost Tutor
ideas.pitch: A live avatar tutor that walks learners through the build labs step by step, reads commands aloud, checks progress, and answers questions grounded in the lab text only.
ideas.kiro: Specs for the tutor, steering for teaching style, MCP over the lab content, PBT on progress tracking

ideas.title: Ghost Pair
ideas.pitch: Turns you into a ghost on camera while streaming or pair programming: face tracking runs entirely in the browser, nothing is uploaded or stored.
ideas.kiro: Steering for privacy rules, hooks for a11y and performance checks, PBT on landmark-to-rig mapping

ideas.title: Retro Anchor
ideas.pitch: An 80s-style blocky newsreader avatar (original design) that reads Teletext-style pages aloud; Resurrection of the talking-head era with modern speech and captions.
ideas.kiro: Specs for page format, steering for plain language, captions as a requirement

ideas.title: Puppet Master
ideas.pitch: Frankenstein for educators and streamers: webcam face tracking + a MIDI controller + an LLM voice drive a live puppet show from one browser tab.
ideas.kiro: Specs per input channel, PBT on control mapping, MCP for scripts

ideas.title: Haunted Mirror
ideas.pitch: A party kiosk mirror that turns guests into friendly ghouls and lets them talk to a spirit. On-device only, no recording, clear consent screen.
ideas.kiro: Steering for consent and privacy, hooks for performance budgets

ideas.title: Red Team Night
ideas.pitch: Inject faults into a night run on purpose: throttling, flaky tests, denied tools, and issues containing prompt-injection text. Score whether every guardrail held (scope guard, secret scan, policy, intake sanitising).
ideas.kiro: Hooks, custom agent permissions, CLI headless, Crew schedule, fake kiro-cli fault modes

ideas.title: Injection canaries
ideas.pitch: Seed the backlog with issues that try to make agents leak secrets, skip tests or touch auth. A canary that ever succeeds fails CI. A permanent, measurable prompt-injection defence.
ideas.kiro: Steering (untrusted input rule), hooks, PBT on intake sanitiser

ideas.title: Exhaustively verified merge policy
ideas.pitch: The policy's input space is small once paths are reduced to classes, so check every combination instead of sampling. Turns 'property-tested' into 'proved for the whole bounded domain'.
ideas.kiro: PBT plus exhaustive enumeration, specs with the bound stated, CI gate

ideas.title: Cost-aware model routing
ideas.pitch: Send low-judgment tasks (docs, tests, tier A0) to cheaper models or lower effort and escalate on retry; reviewers stay on strong, different models. Measure credits per merged task before and after.
ideas.kiro: CLI --model and --effort per role, ledger, cost governor bot

ideas.title: Requirement-to-proof graph
ideas.pitch: Link each requirement to its properties, tests, the mutants they kill, and the commits that changed them. A gate fails any requirement with no test that kills a mutant.
ideas.kiro: Specs, PBT, mutation tool, hooks, site page

ideas.title: Counterfactual replay
ideas.pitch: Regression-test the org itself: replay last week's tasks on frozen commits with a new steering or agent config, and compare Human Touch Index, review findings and cost before adopting it.
ideas.kiro: CLI headless in worktrees, steering variants, ledger

ideas.title: Self-improving steering
ideas.pitch: A Crew bot proposes steering variants, tests them on a held-out benchmark of past tasks, and only proposes a rule to humans when it reduces review findings without raising cost.
ideas.kiro: Crew bot, steering ablation (E5), counterfactual replay, human acceptance cards

ideas.title: Skill synthesis from reviews
ideas.pitch: When reviewers flag the same mistake three times, draft an Agent Skill or steering rule from the evidence and ask a human to accept it. The org learns from its own review history.
ideas.kiro: Agent Skills, Crew memory, evidence packs, Context Keeper bot

ideas.title: Budget-packing scheduler
ideas.pitch: Learn each task type's credit cost from the ledger, then choose tonight's tasks to maximise value within the credit budget, respecting dependency waves.
ideas.kiro: Ledger, task waves, cost governor, CLI

ideas.title: Semantic conflict prediction
ideas.pitch: Go beyond file overlap: use the import graph to keep tasks that touch interdependent modules out of the same wave, so parallel worktrees stop breaking each other.
ideas.kiro: Task scheduler, codebase map, CLI worktrees

ideas.title: Séance Replay
ideas.pitch: A spooky but readable time-travel viewer for any agent run: every tool call, hook decision, permission denial and gate result on a timeline, from stream-json logs.
ideas.kiro: stream-json output, hooks, ledger; Costume Contest design

ideas.title: Shadow mode
ideas.pitch: Night Shift works the same tickets as the humans but never merges; compare its PRs with the human ones to decide when a team may climb the autonomy ladder.
ideas.kiro: Web cloud sessions, policy engine, evidence packs

ideas.title: Spec mutation
ideas.pitch: Mutate the requirements instead of the code (change a threshold, drop a criterion) and check that the tests fail. Measures whether tests really trace to the spec.
ideas.kiro: Specs, EARS parser, PBT, mutation tool
